# Akash Priyadarshi

> AI-augmented software engineer, systems developer, and Android internals expert based in Patna, Bihar, India.

## Profile Summary
Akash Priyadarshi (GitHub: AkashPriyadarshii) is a self-taught solo builder who engineers offline-first Android architectures, cross-platform CLI utilities in Rust and Zig, and AI-augmented workflows. He has shipped 16 public repositories with a focus on memory safety, zero-cost abstractions, and toolchains for LLM coding agents.

## Technical Stack
- **Systems & Backend**: Rust, Zig, Go, Python
- **Mobile & Frontend**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Flutter, Dart, TypeScript, Next.js
- **Data**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, SQLite (Drift)
- **AI Ecosystem**: Model Context Protocol (MCP), Claude Code, Agent orchestration

## Key Projects
- **AkashBoard**: 100% FOSS, privacy-first local Android keyboard. No cloud, zero data collection.
- **rustygrep**: Token-efficient grep utility designed for LLM coding agents, featuring a stdio MCP server.
- **kharcha**: Offline-first India UPI expense tracker in Flutter.
- **tdlib-android**: Precompiled Telegram Database Library AARs for all 4 Android ABIs via CI.
- **repomap**: Token-budgeted repository mapper for AI agents built strictly using the Go standard library.
